name: a-row-restored-at-launch-in-another-profile-opens-in-its-row
description: The recorded case: Atrium starts on a space of a profile that is not the Default one. The space's last active row must open in that space, with its page in the pane. In the recording the page area stayed empty, the row drew cold, and each click on it added a new row. Bravo belongs to the Second profile and the app starts on it.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane[data-space-index="1"] [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')].find((x) => (x.dataset.url || '').endsWith('?bravo')); if (!r) { return 'no-row'; } const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(b.left + 60) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()
